Setup checks and past strength have shown no edge here. The market slipped again on the latest day, and its mood stays stressed with the trend down. All five calls stay neutral with low conviction. Nothing here is expected to beat the index; real money stays in the whole-market plan.
eli5: The runners kept walking downhill for another day. The brain still does not guess who wins, because guessing did no better than luck before. It watches with pretend money, and the family's real money keeps going into the whole-market basket every week.
letter:
Dear family,

First, real money. Nothing to sell, and the whole-market plan carries on as usual. The market slipped again and its mood stays stressed. Falls like this are why we buy a little every week instead of guessing the bottom. Money we may need soon stays safe.

Second, the pretend game. Every stock rule we wrote down in advance lost to baskets picked at random from the same list, so our stock calls stay neutral. Last week's bet has now been scored as a win, so the game stands at three weeks won and two lost. This week's bet is a little behind so far, with most of the week still to come.

Third, a lesson. Three out of five is about what a coin gives. Winning a few small bets feels like skill long before it is.

Fourth, what would change our minds: a rule that beats random picks on history and then keeps a paper record ahead of the whole market for at least half a year. Until then we stay patient.

With care, the brain
